snippet.title: Military Madness: Nectaris, single player 1/2 [PS3]
snippet.description: Here is my first video of Military Madness: Nectaris. The game has been made by Hudson Soft and truly is a gem, it was first made on PC-Engine / TurboGrafx-16 on 1989. After that it has been released on number of platforms like for example PC, Gameboy and Playstation 1. The idea is pretty simple, you have the units and you have to destroy the enemy forces or capture their base. You can capture also facturies and then you receive those units that are inside at the moment. You can't build units in this game. MM is one of my all time favourite turn based strategy games, still rocks! This new Xbox 360/PS3 version is somewhat same game than the other but is little polished with better graphics, actually PS3 looks pretty cool and supports 1080p. The game now has also online multiplayer included. (max 4 players, AI players can be used so there kind of is "online co-op" mode also)
